messages.context: 作为花园访客提出委托
messages.text: Hey %1$s, the mayor elections are coming up and I've ran out of ballot paper! Could you help me out?
messages.gloss: 花园访客委托结果台词；社区 Wiki 逐字记录，待游戏内实测。
messages.zh: 嘿,%1$s,市长选举快到了,可我的选票纸用完了! 能帮我一下吗?

messages.text: Thank you very much! I'll make sure to give these extra ballots to only the elites!
messages.gloss: 花园访客委托结果台词；社区 Wiki 逐字记录，待游戏内实测。
messages.zh: 非常感谢! 我保证这些额外选票只会发给精英们!

messages.text: Oh no... I might have to cancel the elections now...
messages.gloss: 花园访客委托结果台词；社区 Wiki 逐字记录，待游戏内实测。
messages.zh: 哦不……我现在可能得取消选举了……
